headline_item.title_zh: Roku宣布停售智能家居硬件
headline_item.title_en: Roku says it will wind down sales of smart home hardware to focus on streaming, days after Fox closed its acquisition; it will keep supporting existing devices (Janko Roettgers/Lowpass)
headline_item.event_summary_zh: Roku决定停止销售智能摄像头及灯泡等硬件，将业务重心全面回归流媒体核心领域，仅维持现有设备售后
headline_item.event_summary_en: Roku recently announced the phasing out of its smart home hardware division, including cameras and lighting products. The strategic pivot aims to cut non-core losses and refocus on its streaming platform business, while promising continued software support for existing hardware.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】Roku在企业内部战略发布会：停止销售智能家居硬件，保留现有设备的售后服务
【起因与机理】剥离非核心亏损业务，集中资源聚焦流媒体主业
【关键技术规格】Roku决定砍掉智能家居硬件产品线。
【观点态度】业务重心彻底回归流媒体主战场。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Roku (Internal strategic announcement): Discontinuing smart home hardware sales while maintaining existing customer support
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Divesting from non-core, loss-making segments to prioritize streaming growth
[Key Specification] Roku cuts smart home hardware division.
[Perspective & Impact] Full pivot back to core streaming business.
headline_item.industry_impact_zh: 卖电视棒的非要去卖灯泡，折腾一圈发现还是没流量变现好赚。所谓的硬件生态梦碎，不过是科技大厂在烧钱游戏里认怂的经典剧本。
headline_item.industry_impact_en: A classic case of a streaming company trying to 'smart' their way into home goods only to realize hardware is a thankless, low-margin chore. Turns out, sticking to your lane is easier than keeping the lights on in everyone else’s house.

headlines.title_zh: 英伟达董事会启动黄仁勋接班人选拔程序
headlines.title_en: Source: Nvidia's board is working with an outside firm to identify possible replacements for Jensen Huang and weighs naming a temporary CEO during the search (Nina Trentmann/Bloomberg)
headlines.event_summary_zh: 英伟达董事会正与外部猎头合作评估黄仁勋的继任者，并探讨在过渡期设立临时CEO的可能性
headlines.event_summary_en: Nvidia's board has engaged an external firm to identify potential successors for CEO Jensen Huang and is exploring the appointment of an interim CEO during the search. This move aims to ensure long-term governance stability for the AI giant, preparing for a seamless leadership transition.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】英伟达董事会在企业内部治理流程：聘请第三方机构搜寻CEO继任者，并评估设置临时CEO的必要性
【起因与机理】作为市值万亿巨头，需为黄仁勋的长期接班问题提前进行合规的治理安排
【关键技术规格】英伟达董事会正式启动继任者考察工作。
【观点态度】旨在防范治理风险，强化企业长周期稳定性。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Nvidia Board of Directors (Corporate governance process): Engaged an external firm to find a successor and considered an interim CEO role
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Proactive governance planning for the long-term leadership transition of a trillion-dollar company
[Key Specification] Nvidia Board initiates succession planning.
[Perspective & Impact] Goal is to ensure long-term governance and leadership stability.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 全人类的AI算力命脉还攥在“皮衣刀客”手里，董事会就开始搞退休策划，这剧本怕不是想在股价巅峰前先给资本市场打一支强效定心剂。建议各位投资人先别慌，毕竟只要那件皮衣还没脱，谁敢说自己能镇得住这群疯抢GPU的硅谷大佬？
headlines.industry_impact_en: The board is scouting for a successor while the world's AI supply chain is still held firmly in Jensen's leather jacket pocket; this is clearly a tactical move to sedate investors. Until he actually takes off that iconic jacket, no one is really going to believe the throne is up for grabs.

headlines.title_zh: 顶级律所借AI重塑法律业务形态
headlines.title_en: Gilbert + Tobin rethinks the business of law with AI
headlines.event_summary_zh: 澳大利亚顶级律师事务所Gilbert + Tobin通过深度整合AI技术，大幅提升法律咨询与文书处理效率
headlines.event_summary_en: Gilbert + Tobin, a premier Australian law firm, has fully integrated AI into its legal documentation and research processes to tackle increasing workloads. By automating manual legal tasks, the firm aims to optimize service efficiency and cost structures while maintaining high legal standards.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】Gilbert + Tobin律所在律所日常法务与咨询业务场景：深度集成AI辅助法律研究与自动化文档处理
【起因与机理】寻求法律服务效率的边际成本突破，应对行业竞争
【关键技术规格】重构业务流程以提升盈利效率。
【观点态度】重构业务流程以提升盈利效率。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Gilbert + Tobin law firm: Integrating AI for legal research and automated documentation
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Seeking to break efficiency boundaries and improve competitive edge
[Perspective & Impact] Restructuring workflows for better profitability.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 律师行业的本质是卖时间，现在AI把卖时间的门槛拉低了，律所合伙人与其说是拥抱科技，不如说是担心被更早用上AI的后浪卷死。毕竟，只要模型写得够快，客户哪怕再多，律师也不用在大半夜熬夜改合同了。
headlines.industry_impact_en: The legal business is basically selling time, and AI is here to deflate that hourly rate. It’s not just tech-forwardness; it’s survival—because whoever masters the prompt first, gets to actually go home on time.

titans.quote_zh:
人们应该始终掌控未来。

OpenAI 反对这样一种观念，即人们被降级到做“人工智能系统认为对人类有意义的奖励”的事情是可以接受的。

titans.quote_en:
People should always be in control of the future.

OpenAI is against the notion that it would be acceptable for people to be relegated to a role of doing things that “AI systems think makes sense to reward in humans”.

People should not cede control of the future to superintelligence, and that requirement should ultimately constrain AI progress.
